reasoning_content:
This codebase is severely broken. There are probably hundreds of missing imports. This is beyond what can be fixed with simple patches. Let me try using --noEmit with --force and just run the server without a proper build.

Actually, there was probably a better approach - use --transpileOnly or directly run with ts-node.

Let me check if tsx is installed, that could run TypeScript directly.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'ENDOFSCRIPT'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Check for tsx or ts-node
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria/server && npx tsx --version 2>&1 || echo no tsx")
print("tsx:", stdout.read().decode())

# Try running src/index.ts directly with tsx
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria/server && SUPABASE_URL=x SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=x npx tsx src/index.ts 2>&1 | head -20")
print("\nRun tsx:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
ENDOFSCRIPT
